core.title: 4-1/2 Inch Swing Clear Hinge, PBB SCBB8145

text.description_html:
PBB SCBB8145 4-1/2" Swing Clear Hinge

Standard duty .134" thickness ball bearing swing clear hinge. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design, Brushed Chrome finish. For standard weight / average frequency use doors with square door edge.

Swing clear hinges are used when conditions require the door to completely clear the opening at 90 degrees.

Specifications: for PBB SCBB8145 Swing Clear Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Two (2) Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Standard Duty)
  • Hinge Material: Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • For Square Door Edge
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8122
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
